results.title: Codes of primitive programs
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $p$ be a primitive program with $m$ instructions, valid for $r$ registers. Then $\mu_{\operatorname{code}(p)}(i)=p_i$ for every $i<m$ and $\mu_{\operatorname{code}(p)}(i)=\mathrm{halt}$ for $i\ge m$. Consequently, for every $n\in\mathbb N$, Moreover $\operatorname{code}(p)<2^{w(p)(4m+1)+1}$, and if $m\ge2$ then $\operatorname{code}(p)+1\ge2^{w(p)(4m-7)+1}$.

results.title: The complete 2-descent map is a homomorphism
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $K$ be a field with $2\ne0$ and $d\in K^\times$. Then $\delta_d(P+Q)=\delta_d(P)\,\delta_d(Q)$ for all $P,Q\in C_d(K)$, so $\delta_d$ is a group homomorphism $C_d(K)\to(K^\times/K^{\times2})^2$. Moreover $\delta_d(2P)=1$ for every $P\in C_d(K)$, so $2C_d(K)$ lies in its kernel.

results.title: The descent map is the Kummer map of the coverings
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $K$ be a field with $2\ne0$ and $d\in K^\times$, and let $k(P)=(k_1(P),k_2(P))\in K\times K$ be the Kummer map of the coverings of $C_d$: $(1,1)$ at $O$; $(-1,-d)$, $(d,2)$, $(-d,-2d)$ at $(0,0)$, $(d,0)$, $(-d,0)$; and $(x,x-d)$ at every other point $(x,y)$. Then for every $P\in C_d(K)$ both $k_1(P)$ and $k_2(P)$ are nonzero, and $\delta_d(P)$ is the pair of their square classes.

results.title: The halving lemma
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $K$ be a field with $2\ne0$ and $d\in K^\times$, and let $(x,y)\in C_d(K)$. If $x=r_1^2$, $x-d=r_2^2$ and $x+d=r_3^2$ for some $r_1,r_2,r_3\in K$, then $(x,y)=2Q$ for some $Q\in C_d(K)$.

results.title: The two-torsion of a congruent number curve
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $K$ be a field with $2\ne0$ and $d\in K^\times$. The points $P\in C_d(K)$ with $2P=O$ are exactly $O$, $(0,0)$, $(d,0)$ and $(-d,0)$, and these are four distinct points; so $C_d(K)[2]$ has exactly $4$ elements.

results.summary: Let $d$ be a positive integer. For $P\in C_d(\mathbb Q)$ with $\delta_d(P)=(\alpha,\beta)$, let $s(P)=(r(\alpha),r(\beta))\in\mathbb Z^2$ be the pair of squarefree representatives. Then the x-form of the covering $D_{s(P)}$ holds over $\mathbb Q$, and $s(P)\in\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_d)$. For $P,Q\in C_d(\mathbb Q)$ (and any natural number $d$), $s(P)=s(Q)$ if and only if $\delta_d(P)=\delta_d(Q)$.

results.title: Counting $A/2A$
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $A$ be a finitely generated abelian group whose $2$-torsion $A[2]$ has exactly $4$ elements and which has an element of infinite order, and suppose that $A/2A$ is finite. Then $A/2A$ has at least $8$ elements.

results.title: Positive rank and a Selmer group of order eight give every Selmer class (RK9)
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $d$ be a positive integer. Suppose that $C_d(\mathbb Q)$ is finitely generated, that it has a point of infinite order, and that $\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_d)$ has exactly $8$ elements. Then for every $(a,b)\in\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_d)$ the x-form of the covering $D_{a,b}$ holds over $\mathbb Q$.
